introTr: B1 yolculuğunun son durağına yaklaştın. Bu denemede aktarma, bağlaçlar ve sınıf dili gibi konuların hepsi birlikte karşına çıkacak; bazı sorular biraz zor olabilir ve bu normal. Acele etmeden, kendi hızında çöz.

items.q: If the bus had come on time, we ___ the beginning of the show.
items.whyTr: Geçmişteki gerçek dışı durum: If + had V3, would have V3.

items.q: Emre said, 'I will help you.' Emre said that he ___ me.
The parent asked, 'Where is the nurse's office?' The parent asked ___.
items.whyTr: Aktarılan soruda düz cümle sırası ve zaman kayması.

items.q: 'Do you have a hall pass?' The teacher asked me ___ a hall pass.
items.whyTr: Evet/hayır sorusu aktarılırken if/whether + düz cümle sırası.

items.q: 'Please open your books.' The teacher asked the students ___ their books.
items.whyTr: Rica aktarılırken asked + kişi + to + fiil.

items.q: 'Don't run in the hallway.' The teacher told us ___ in the hallway.
items.whyTr: Olumsuz emir aktarılırken told + kişi + not to + fiil.

items.q: The classroom is ___ small for thirty students.
items.whyTr: Gereğinden fazla ve sorun yaratan durum için too kullanılır.

items.q: This test is not as hard ___ the last one.
I wish I ___ more time to prepare.
items.whyTr: Şimdiki pişmanlık/istek için wish + geçmiş zaman.

items.q: Please ___ these worksheets to the students.
Please ___ the markers after class.
Could you ___ this form with your name and address?
items.whyTr: Fill in a form, formu doldurmak demektir.

items.q: I will ___ the class while Ms. Carter is at a meeting.
It was ___ a hot day that the students stayed inside.
items.whyTr: Such + a + sıfat + isim; so + sıfat.

items.q: The test was ___ difficult that nobody finished.
items.whyTr: So + sıfat + that: o kadar ... ki.

items.q: ___ the rain, we had the field trip.
items.whyTr: Despite + isim: -e rağmen. Although'dan sonra tam cümle gelir.

items.q: The bus was late. ___, we missed the first activity.
We canceled the picnic ___ the storm.
items.whyTr: Because of + isim; because + tam cümle.

items.q: You're a new teacher, ___?
items.whyTr: Olumlu cümlenin soru eki olumsuz olur: aren't you?

passages.title: A difficult first day
passages.text:
Hafsa's first day as a substitute was such a long day that she fell asleep on the couch at eight o'clock. The morning began well. Despite being nervous, she arrived early and read the sub plan carefully.

But the fifth graders were so noisy that she had to ask them three times to sit down. Because of a broken heater, the room was too cold, so the students wore their jackets. At lunch, a boy told her that he had lost his lunch money. Hafsa helped him look for it, and they found it under his desk.

In spite of the difficulties, Hafsa felt proud. At the end of the day, a girl asked her if she would come back tomorrow. Hafsa smiled and said she hoped so.

questions.q: Why did Hafsa fall asleep early?
options: It was a very long day.
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'such a long day that she fell asleep'.

questions.q: Why did the students wear their jackets?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'Because of a broken heater, the room was too cold'.

questions.q: What did the girl ask Hafsa at the end of the day?
options: Whether she would come back the next day
If she had lost her money
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'asked her if she would come back tomorrow'.

passages.title: A note from the teacher
passages.text:
When Hafsa arrived in Room 14, she found this note on the desk.

'Dear Substitute,
Thank you for looking after my class today. Please take attendance first. Then hand out the blue worksheets and ask the students to fill in their names. The class is friendly, but Jake is sometimes too talkative to focus, so please seat him near your desk. The students told me that they would like to watch a short video at the end if they finish early. After lunch, ask them to put away their books and start silent reading. Before you leave, please write a note about how the day went. If you have any problems, call Mr. Brown at extension 12.
Thanks, Ms. Carter'

questions.q: Why should Hafsa seat Jake near her desk?
options: He is too talkative to focus.
questions.whyTr: Not: 'Jake is sometimes too talkative to focus'.

questions.q: What would the students like to do if they finish early?
questions.whyTr: Not: 'they would like to watch a short video at the end if they finish early'.

questions.q: What should Hafsa do before she leaves?
options: Write a note about the day
questions.whyTr: Not: 'please write a note about how the day went'.

passages.title: New phone rule
passages.text:
Dear families,

Starting next month, students will not be allowed to use their phones during class. Dr. Lopez explained that phones had become a serious distraction. Many teachers have noticed that students participate less when their phones are nearby. Therefore, all phones must be kept in lockers from 8:30 until 3:00.

Parents who need to reach their children can call the front office. During a trial period last spring, test scores went up, and as a result, the school decided to make the rule permanent. Students who break the rule will receive a warning first. After the second warning, a parent will be called.

Thank you for your support.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the message?
options: To ask parents to buy phones
To explain how to use lockers
To inform families about a new phone rule

questions.q: What happened during the trial period last spring?
What happens after a student's second warning?
options: The phone is taken away forever.
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'After the second warning, a parent will be called.'

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Very well. Dr. Lopez said that the school needs more substitutes this fall.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Did she ask you to start soon?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: She asked me whether I could start on Monday. And she told me not to worry about the paperwork. Mr. Brown will help.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: That's great! Did she say how much it pays?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: She said it pays about a hundred dollars a day, but I'm still waiting for the contract.

questions.q: What did Dr. Lopez say the school needs?
questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'the school needs more substitutes this fall'.

questions.q: What did Dr. Lopez ask Hafsa?
options: Whether she could start on Monday
questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'She asked me whether I could start on Monday.'

questions.q: What did Dr. Lopez tell Hafsa not to worry about?
questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'she told me not to worry about the paperwork'.

script.speaker: Mr. Evans
script.text: You're the new substitute, aren't you?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, I am. I'm Hafsa. It's my first week.

script.speaker: Mr. Evans
script.text: Nice to meet you. You haven't been in the lounge before, have you?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: No, I haven't. It's very comfortable!

script.speaker: Mr. Evans
script.text: The coffee is free, by the way. And good luck with fifth grade. They are such an energetic class!

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you. I hope I'm ready.

questions.q: How long has Hafsa been at the school?
What is free in the lounge?
How does Mr. Evans describe the fifth graders?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I made a mistake today. I gave the students the wrong worksheet.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I should have checked the sub plan again before I handed it out.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Next time, arrive fifteen minutes earlier. And don't worry. Everyone makes mistakes.

options: She gave the students the wrong worksheet.
questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'I gave the students the wrong worksheet.'

writing.promptTr: Bir gün substitute teacher olarak çalıştın. Sınıfın öğretmenine kısa bir not yaz (80-120 kelime): gün nasıl geçti, kimler ne söyledi, bir sorun ve ne yaptın, yarın için bir öneri.
writing.promptEn: You worked as a substitute teacher today. Write a note to the regular teacher (80-120 words). Say how the day went, what a student told or asked you, one problem and what you did, and one suggestion.
checklistTr: Günü anlatırken geçmiş zaman kullandım mı?
Bir öğrencinin söylediğini aktardım mı (A student told me that ... / asked me if ...)?
Bir sebep-sonuç sözü kullandım mı (because of, as a result, despite)?
Bir phrasal verb kullandım mı (hand out, put away, look after)?
Bir öneri veya pişmanlık cümlesi yazdım mı (should have / next time)?
Selamlama ve kapanış var mı; cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor mu?
writing.model:
Dear Ms. Carter,

Thank you for letting me look after your class today. The day went well, despite a few problems. I handed out the blue worksheets, and the students filled in their names quickly. A boy told me that he had lost his pencil, so I lent him one. Because of the noise in the hallway, the class was distracted for ten minutes. As a result, we finished the reading activity a little late. I should have started the video earlier. Next time, I would suggest a shorter activity before lunch. The students put away their books nicely.

Sincerely,
Hafsa
